== Summary ==
Slip “•I’m Ready For Anything” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (1112, 969, 1624, 1691)). Version [[I'm Ready For Anything]] (Original). Not a recreation.
